x: The Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 for simultaneous polls inserts Art. 82A and amends Art. 83 (duration of Parliament), Art. 172 (duration of State Legislatures) and Art. 327 – so 83 (and 172) need amendment. Art. 356 was only named in the debate (Law Commission 2018 draft); Art. 246 is not involved.
source: Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 (prsindia.org/billtrack); app notes (old-notes.txt) 2:64 sub 9
evidence: old notes 2:64 sub 9: Bill amends 83, 172, 327; debate also names 85, 174, 356
Kovind HLC report (onoe.gov.in): amendments to Art. 83 and 172
dispute: The CGPSC official key is Article 356. Strictly, the 129th Amendment Bill (2024) amends Articles 83, 172 and 327 and inserts 82A, so Articles 83 and 172 are also correct.
